linode.note: API memory and disk counters use 1024-based product sizing and are recorded as MiB. Current non-GPU classes with no successor were selected.

vultr.note: API memory counters use 1024-based product sizing and are recorded as MiB; disk is recorded in GB. Paid single-disk vc2/vhf/vhp/voc products were selected.

scaleway.note: Memory is reported in bytes. Volume constraints are limits; included disk capacity is omitted. Snapshot zone: fr-par-1; selected non-GPU families.

hetzner.note: Cost-optimized CX/CAX specifications; stock varies and is not encoded.

ovh.note: The reviewed current product page labels this range VPS 2027.

google.note: GB labels are preserved from the reviewed machine-specification table; the builder converts explicit source units to GiB tiers.

oracle.note: PND-authored valid flexible configurations; E5 x86 OCPU is two vCPUs, A1 OCPU is one vCPU. Storage is separately configured.

oneprovider.note: Only published resource dimensions are recorded. Architecture is omitted where unspecified. OneCloud entries differing only in traffic are combined.

dedirock-la.note: Only published resource dimensions are recorded. Architecture is omitted where unspecified. OneCloud entries differing only in traffic are combined.

dedirock-ny.note: Only published resource dimensions are recorded. Architecture is omitted where unspecified. OneCloud entries differing only in traffic are combined.

dedirock-storage.note: Only published resource dimensions are recorded. Architecture is omitted where unspecified. OneCloud entries differing only in traffic are combined.
